Globe.title: Raw fire counts rose up to {ratio}×. The fires did not.
Globe.body: Between the 2005 and 2024 Measured Epochs, raw detections rose {mekong}× in the Mekong and {amazon}× in the Amazon as new sensors joined the record: Suomi NPP (2012), NOAA-20 (2019), NOAA-21 (2024). Corrected for sensor physics, the harmonized series is flat to falling, apart from the real 2010 drought peak.

Evidence.title: Evidence · 5 scientific figures
Evidence.subtitle: Published figures
Evidence.caption1: MODIS and VIIRS footprint growth with scan angle, and the area ratio that drives harmonization.
Evidence.caption2: Coincident overpasses, solar zenith screening and the de-duplication that removes double counting.
Evidence.caption3: Quantile mapping aligns VIIRS FRP to the MODIS-equivalent reference without flattening the tail.
Evidence.caption4: Raw detections rise as sensors are added; the harmonized series removes the step changes.
Evidence.caption5: The 26-year by 73-pentad calendar with observed, modelled and severe-anomaly cells.
Evidence.quickScanDetail: MODIS edge {modis} km² vs VIIRS nadir {viirs} km²
Evidence.table1: Footprint area by sensor and scan angle
Evidence.scanBody: A MODIS edge pixel covers 9.69 km²; a VIIRS nadir pixel covers 0.13 km². One fire lights up many more VIIRS pixels, so raw counts grow with the sensor, not the fire.
Evidence.calBody: Quantile mapping aligns VIIRS FRP to the MODIS-equivalent reference without flattening the tail. The KS distance falls after harmonization.
Evidence.limitWindow: Each Measured Epoch is a single 5-day window. The other pentads of the calendar are modelled from the seasonal envelope and are never scored.
Evidence.limitHoldout: On held-out years after {year}, the calibration lowers RMSE by {gain} MW; its 95% interval ({low} to {high} MW) {significant, select, yes {excludes zero} other {spans zero, so the held-out gain is not significant}}.
Evidence.limitInSample: The R² and KS improvements are measured in-sample on the co-incident Aqua–Suomi-NPP pairs.
Evidence.limitReproduce: Reproduce with `uv run python -m benchmark_cli.run_experiments`; every figure on this page is read from data/processed/empirical_results.json.

Review.saveFailed: The decision could not be saved. Nothing was recorded; try again.
Review.queueSub: Agent runs that propose an action. Each row opens the full evidence and the decision rail.
Review.emptyQueue: No runs waiting for a decision.
Review.noBulk: Runs are decided one at a time. There is no bulk or automatic approval.
Review.chipHint: select a number to see its source
Review.viBriefNote: The briefing is written in English by the model. Changing the audience changes the wording only, not the numbers.
Review.errNote: Add a note when the reason is Other.
Review.finalNote: Decisions are read-only once recorded. A correction is a new run.
Review.reasonOnly: Reasoning summary only. Hidden chain-of-thought is never shown.
Review.readOnly: Records cannot be edited, deleted or undone. A correction is a new run with its own record.
Review.withheldBody: The decision was recorded. No briefing text is shown for withheld runs.
Review.approveStays: Approve stays unavailable. Reject, or re-run to correct the evidence.
Review.msgApprove: This releases the briefing and authorizes the field action.
Review.msgReject: Nothing will be released. The decision is recorded and cannot be edited.
Review.readOnlyLong: Read-only record. A correction is a new run.
Review.sfaiNotUsed: This decision does not use SFAI, so no score is shown here. The Workbench may show an SFAI for the same region and year; the two are not in conflict.
Review.notReleased: Not released · waiting for a decision
